reason: A measured time (the battery per unit, the page latency) jitters between runs of the same tree; at 0 % the budget check would fail on noise, not on a regression. The limits themselves (battery.unit_time_limit, the bundle and latency budgets) are seconds and bytes, which D-337 does not touch. Ends when the budget check compares the whole sample against its limit instead of a p95 against a baseline.
